svg.title: How a Chrome extension reaches the Chrome Web Store
svg.desc: Merging the release pull request publishes the release, whose isolated build zips the extension from the signed tag and attests it. The workflow Chrome Web Store asks the store for the state of the item, takes the zip only with its provenance, signs in to Google with the OIDC token of GitHub and no stored secret, uploads it and submits it for review. Google reviews it and publishes it to the users; the daily run delivers a release whose review had to wait and reports a rejection.
